description: This Java class 'GatewayConnector' manages HTTP connections to the eWay payment gateway, including setting timeouts, sending requests, and handling responses.

classes.name: GatewayConnector
classes.description: Handles HTTP communication with the eWay payment gateway, including request sending and response processing.

methods.name: GatewayConnector
methods.description: Default constructor setting timeout to 60 seconds.
